```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = iris,
       mapping = aes(x = Sepal.Width,
                     y = Sepal.Length,
                     color = Species)) + geom_point() + labs(title = "Measurements for Different Species of Iris", subtitle = "Virgincia has the longest sepals", caption = "Fisher (1936)")
```
